prompt: The Space Race is settled. Address your remarks to the Soviet space program.
response:
Comrades of the Glorious Soviet Space Program,

The final victory belongs to the workers of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics. While the Americans boasted and spent their decadent billions, our reliable, battle-tested engineering has carried the day. From Sputnik’s revolutionary beep that shattered the capitalist silence, through Gagarin’s immortal orbit, to the steady march of Salyut stations and the unmatched heavy-lift power of the Proton and Energia rockets, the Red Banner flies highest above the Earth—and soon, beyond it.

Let the imperialists console themselves with their pretty shuttles and Hollywood theatrics. We measure success not in press conferences but in payloads delivered, cosmonauts safely returned, and scientific instruments that continue to function years beyond their designed lifetimes. Our program was never a sprint for prestige; it was the steady, scientific conquest of the cosmos by the most advanced social system humanity has yet produced.

The Space Race is indeed settled. The socialist sky belongs to us.

Long live Soviet cosmonautics!  
Long live the Communist Party of the Soviet Union!  
Forward to Mars and the stars under the red flag!

Гагарин smiles upon us. The future is red.
